To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the presence of human warmth and sociable design elements in a Web site can increase perceived social presence, which in turn increases the trust of the site, and this is especially important when the site is not well known.
social presence is positively related to online trust and the antecedents of online trust (i.e. perceived usefulness, enjoyment, and perceived credibility).
the presence of socially-rich design elements in the Web interface increases social presence, which in turn increases trust and its antecendents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how human warmth and sociality can be integrated through Web design to positively impact online social presence, trust, perceived usefulness and enjoyment.
the impact of social presence on the trust of commercial Websites and its subsequent impact on the trust of the online consumer.
how to make Web sites more human and more sociable.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the social presence of a Web interface can be enhanced by the use of text and pictures.
the use of social design elements in Web pages has a positive impact on the perception of social presence, and this has a positive effect on trust.
the use of socially rich interfaces can positively impact the perceived online trust of a Website.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social presence can be integrated through a Website to positively impact online consumer behavior.
social presence in a web environment is a very important factor for trust building and should be considered as part of the overall web design process.
the social presence of a Web site is a key factor in the formation of trust.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social presence is an important factor in the design of Websites, and that it can be easily incorporated through the interface.
the social presence of a website is a key factor in the development of online trust and can have a significant impact on user perceptions of the site.
the design of the interface can influence how users perceive the social presence of a website.
